name: factory
description: The factory loop: ideate, spec, build, ship, and feature to run a whole feature. The Linear issue is the thread, sessions are disposable, and you step in at most four times per ticket.

interface.shortDescription: A lean software factory: idea to merged pull request, with Linear as the thread.
interface.longDescription: Five skills that carry a ticket from a spoken idea to a merged pull request: ideate files options, spec writes a buildable spec, build opens the pull request with evidence, ship merges and checks it live, and feature drives a whole parent issue sub-issue by sub-issue. Every run starts by reading the Linear issue and ends by writing to it.
